office_does: A District Court judge presides over most criminal misdemeanor cases in Whatcom County, plus traffic infractions, small claims and other civil disputes.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Jonathan Rands, elected in 2022 and now presiding judge, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since January 2023 and the court's presiding judge, after 20 years as a trial attorney focused largely on DUI defense; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected in 2022 over a deputy prosecutor, with 62% in the election-night count; presiding judge in 2026 [S3][S6]
20 years as a trial attorney with over 200 cases tried to verdict [S1][S2]
In 2023 a Superior Court ruling removed him from 123 DUI cases after the prosecutor's office filed affidavits of prejudice [S5]
Opened Zoom viewing of court hearings to the public in 2026 with the Superior Court presiding judge [S6]
